1import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
2import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
3import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
4 
5type ManifestEntry = {
6  path: string;
7  hash: string;
8  lines: number;
9  bytes: number;
10  group: string;
11};
12 
13const handbookPath = 'docs/offline/index.html';
14const exactRootFiles = new Set([
15  '.dockerignore',
16  '.editorconfig',
17  '.env.example',
18  '.gitignore',
19  '.npmrc',
20  '.prettierignore',
21  '.prettierrc.json',
22  'CODEMAP.md',
23  'Dockerfile',
24  'LICENSE',
25  'README.md',
26  'compose.production.yaml',
27  'compose.yaml',
28  'eslint.config.mjs',
29  'package.json',
30  'playwright.config.ts',
31  'pnpm-workspace.yaml',
32  'tsconfig.base.json',
33  'tsconfig.json',
34]);
35const textExtensions = new Set([
36  '.conf',
37  '.css',
38  '.example',
39  '.html',
40  '.js',
41  '.json',
42  '.md',
43  '.mjs',
44  '.prisma',
45  '.ps1',
46  '.sql',
47  '.toml',
48  '.ts',
49  '.yaml',
50  '.yml',
51]);
52 
53/** Нормализует path для точного сравнения Windows и Linux manifests. */
54function normalizePath(path: string): string {
55  return path.replaceAll('\\', '/');
56}
57 
58/** Возвращает расширение имени для independent allowlist verifier. */
59function extension(path: string): string {
60  const name = path.split('/').at(-1) ?? path;
61  const dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
62  return dot > 0 ? name.slice(dot).toLowerCase() : '';
63}
64 
65/** Повторяет security allowlist generator; любое расхождение ломает CI. */
66function shouldEmbed(path: string): boolean {
67  const normalized = normalizePath(path);
68  if (normalized === handbookPath || normalized === 'pnpm-lock.yaml') return false;
69  if (
70    normalized === '.env' ||
71    (normalized.includes('/.env') && !normalized.endsWith('.env.example'))
72  ) {
73    return false;
74  }
75  return exactRootFiles.has(normalized) || textExtensions.has(extension(normalized));
76}
77 
78/** Независимо открывает список source из Git, не доверяя embedded manifest. */
79function discoverPaths(): string[] {
80  const output = execFileSync(
81    'git',
82    ['ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z'],
83    {
84      encoding: 'utf8',
85    },
86  );
87  return [...new Set(output.split('\0').filter(Boolean).map(normalizePath))]
88    .filter(shouldEmbed)
89    .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, 'en'));
90}
91 
92/** Повторяет стабильный anchor algorithm для независимой проверки внутренних ссылок. */
93function fileAnchor(path: string): string {
94  return `file-${normalizePath(path)}`
95    .toLowerCase()
96    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
97    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
98}
99 
100/** Прерывает проверку генератора с конкретной причиной рассинхронизации документации. */
101function assertGenerated(condition: unknown, message: string): asserts condition {
102  if (!condition) throw new Error(message);
103}
104 
105/** Извлекает JSON manifest из автономного HTML без стороннего DOM parser. */
106function readManifest(html: string): ManifestEntry[] {
107  const match = html.match(
108    /<script id="source-manifest" type="application\/json">([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/,
109  );
110  assertGenerated(match?.[1], 'Offline handbook has no embedded source manifest');
111  return JSON.parse(match[1]) as ManifestEntry[];
112}
113 
114/** Считает тот же нормализованный SHA-256, который записывает generator. */
115function currentHash(path: string): string {
116  const content = readFileSync(path, 'utf8').replaceAll('\r\n', '\n');
117  return createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
118}
119 
120/** Проверяет полноту, актуальность, offline-режим, line anchors и отсутствие secret-файлов. */
121function main(): void {
122  const html = readFileSync(handbookPath, 'utf8');
123  const manifest = readManifest(html);
124  const expectedPaths = discoverPaths();
125  const actualPaths = manifest.map((entry) => entry.path);
126  assertGenerated(html.length > 250_000, 'Offline handbook is unexpectedly small');
127  assertGenerated(
128    JSON.stringify(actualPaths) === JSON.stringify(expectedPaths),
129    'Offline source list is stale; run pnpm docs:offline',
130  );
131  assertGenerated(!actualPaths.includes('.env'), 'Secret .env was embedded');
132  assertGenerated(
133    actualPaths.every((path) => !path.includes('node_modules') && path !== 'pnpm-lock.yaml'),
134    'Dependency/cache file was embedded',
135  );
136 
137  const required = [
138    'apps/web/src/app/storefront.component.ts',
139    'apps/api/src/shop.service.ts',
140    'apps/worker/src/worker.service.ts',
141    'apps/mock-provider/src/provider.service.ts',
142    'packages/database/prisma/migrations/20260831210000_init/migration.sql',
143    'tests/race/run.ts',
144    'tests/production/run.ts',
145    'tests/e2e/storefront.spec.ts',
146    '.github/workflows/ci.yml',
147    'Dockerfile',
148    'README.md',
149    'CODEMAP.md',
150  ];
151  for (const path of required) {
152    assertGenerated(actualPaths.includes(path), `Required offline source is missing: ${path}`);
153    assertGenerated(html.includes(`id="${fileAnchor(path)}"`), `File anchor is missing: ${path}`);
154  }
155 
156  for (const entry of manifest) {
157    assertGenerated(
158      entry.hash === currentHash(entry.path),
159      `Embedded source is stale: ${entry.path}`,
160    );
161    assertGenerated(
162      entry.lines > 0 && entry.bytes >= 0 && entry.group,
163      `Bad manifest: ${entry.path}`,
164    );
165  }
166  assertGenerated(!/<script\s+[^>]*src=/i.test(html), 'Offline handbook loads an external script');
167  assertGenerated(
168    !/<link\s+[^>]*href=["']https?:/i.test(html),
169    'Offline handbook loads external CSS',
170  );
171  assertGenerated(
172    (html.match(/class="source-file"/g) ?? []).length === manifest.length,
173    'Not every manifest file has a rendered source card',
174  );
175  console.log(`Offline handbook verified: ${manifest.length} exact source files.`);
176}
177 
178main();

1import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
2import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
3import ts from 'typescript';
4 
5type Declaration =
6  | ts.ConstructorDeclaration
7  | ts.FunctionDeclaration
8  | ts.GetAccessorDeclaration
9  | ts.MethodDeclaration
10  | ts.SetAccessorDeclaration;
11 
12/** Получает все TypeScript-исходники проекта, исключая dependencies/build/generated code. */
13function sourcePaths(): string[] {
14  return execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '*.ts'], {
15    encoding: 'utf8',
16  })
17    .split(/\r?\n/)
18    .filter(Boolean)
19    .filter((path) => !path.includes('/dist/') && !path.includes('/node_modules/'))
20    .sort();
21}
22 
23/** Определяет объявления методов/функций, для которых пользователь потребовал русское объяснение. */
24function isDocumentedDeclaration(node: ts.Node): node is Declaration {
25  return (
26    ts.isConstructorDeclaration(node) ||
27    ts.isFunctionDeclaration(node) ||
28    ts.isGetAccessorDeclaration(node) ||
29    ts.isMethodDeclaration(node) ||
30    ts.isSetAccessorDeclaration(node)
31  );
32}
33 
34/** Возвращает читаемое имя объявления для отчёта CI. */
35function declarationName(node: Declaration): string {
36  if (ts.isConstructorDeclaration(node)) return 'constructor';
37  return node.name?.getText() ?? '<anonymous>';
38}
39 
40/** Рекурсивно собирает объявления и проверяет непосредственно предшествующий русский комментарий. */
41function inspectFile(path: string): { checked: number; failures: string[] } {
42  const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
43  const source = ts.createSourceFile(path, text, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, ts.ScriptKind.TS);
44  const failures: string[] = [];
45  let checked = 0;
46 
47  /** Обходит AST, не считая inline callbacks отдельными публичными методами проекта. */
48  function visit(node: ts.Node): void {
49    if (isDocumentedDeclaration(node)) {
50      checked += 1;
51      const leading = text.slice(node.getFullStart(), node.getStart(source));
52      if (!/\/\*[\s\S]*[А-Яа-яЁё][\s\S]*\*\/|\/\/[^\n]*[А-Яа-яЁё]/.test(leading)) {
53        const { line } = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.getStart(source));
54        failures.push(`${path}:${line + 1} ${declarationName(node)}`);
55      }
56    }
57    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
58  }
59 
60  visit(source);
61  return { checked, failures };
62}
63 
64/** Проверяет весь проект и ломает CI, если новый метод появился без русского комментария. */
65function main(): void {
66  let checked = 0;
67  const failures: string[] = [];
68  for (const path of sourcePaths()) {
69    const result = inspectFile(path);
70    checked += result.checked;
71    failures.push(...result.failures);
72  }
73  if (failures.length) {
74    throw new Error(`Russian method comments are missing:\n${failures.join('\n')}`);
75  }
76  console.log(`Russian comments verified for ${checked}/${checked} methods and functions.`);
77}
78 
79main();
80

3/** Собирает только реальные console/page errors и возвращает снимок для финального assertion. */
4function trackBrowserErrors(page: Page): () => string[] {
5  const errors: string[] = [];
6  page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(`pageerror: ${error.message}`));
7  page.on('console', (message) => {
8    if (message.type() === 'error') errors.push(`console: ${message.text()}`);
9  });
10  return () => errors;
11}

101/** Проверяет 201/200 replay, 409 при смене payload и запрет клиентских денежных полей. */
102async function verifyIdempotency(): Promise<Record<string, string | number | boolean>> {
103  await client.reset();
104  const intent = newIntent();
105  const clicks = await Promise.all([
106    client.createOrder({ intent }),
107    client.createOrder({ intent }),
108  ]);
109  const statuses = clicks.map((item) => item.status).sort();
110  assertCondition(statuses[0] === 200 && statuses[1] === 201, 'Double click is not idempotent');
111  const conflict = await client.createOrder({ intent, sku: 'STEAM-TOPUP-1000' });
112  const tamper = await client.createOrder({ extraBody: { finalPriceMinor: 1 } });
113  assertCondition(conflict.status === 409, 'Changed replay payload was accepted');
114  assertCondition(tamper.status === 400, 'Client money field was accepted');
115  return {
116    firstStatus: 201,
117    replayStatus: 200,
118    conflictStatus: conflict.status,
119    tamperStatus: tamper.status,
120    serverPriceMinor: clicks[0].body.finalPriceMinor,
121  };
122}

124/** Отправляет 50 одинаковых и 50 разных paid webhook на публичный HTTPS API. */
125async function verifyWebhookRaces(): Promise<Record<string, string | number | boolean>> {
126  await client.reset();
127  const duplicateOrder = await client.createOrder();
128  const eventId = `evt_${randomUUID()}`;
129  const duplicates = await Promise.all(
130    Array.from({ length: 50 }, () =>
131      client.webhook({ orderId: duplicateOrder.body.orderId, eventId }),
132    ),
133  );
134  assertCondition(
135    duplicates.every((item) => item.status === 200),
136    'Duplicate delivery lost HTTP 200',
137  );
138  const first = await client.waitForStatus(duplicateOrder.body.orderId, 'delivered');
139  const snapshot = JSON.stringify({
140    status: first.status,
141    code: first.code,
142    history: first.history,
143  });
144  await Promise.all(
145    Array.from({ length: 10 }, () =>
146      client.webhook({ orderId: duplicateOrder.body.orderId, eventId }),
147    ),
148  );
149  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
150  const replay = (await client.order(duplicateOrder.body.orderId)).body;
151  assertCondition(
152    JSON.stringify({ status: replay.status, code: replay.code, history: replay.history }) ===
153      snapshot,
154    'Repeated event_id changed public order state',
155  );
156 
157  const uniqueOrder = await client.createOrder();
158  const unique = await Promise.all(
159    Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => client.webhook({ orderId: uniqueOrder.body.orderId })),
160  );
161  assertCondition(
162    unique.every((item) => item.status === 200),
163    'Unique paid webhook was rejected',
164  );
165  const uniqueResult = await client.waitForStatus(uniqueOrder.body.orderId, 'delivered');
166  assertCondition(
167    Boolean(uniqueResult.code),
168    'Unique webhook race did not deliver one public code',
169  );
170  assertCondition(
171    uniqueResult.history.filter((item) => item.to === 'delivered').length === 1,
172    'Unique webhook race exposed more than one delivered transition',
173  );
174  return {
175    identicalRequests: duplicates.length,
176    uniqueRequests: unique.length,
177    duplicateNoOp: true,
178    deliveredTransitions: uniqueResult.history.filter((item) => item.to === 'delivered').length,
179  };
180}

182/** Проверяет ранний paid и неупорядоченную цепочку failed→paid→failed через публичный read model. */
183async function verifyOrdering(): Promise<Record<string, string | number | boolean>> {

195  await client.webhook({ orderId: unordered.body.orderId, status: 'failed' });

203}

310function errorMessage(error: unknown): string | null {
311  if (!error) return null;
312  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
313  if (typeof error === 'string') return error;
314  return 'Unknown production acceptance error';

331/** Запускает полную destructive-demo проверку только при явном флаге и всегда возвращает seed. */
332async function main(): Promise<void> {
333  assertCondition(adminToken, 'PRODUCTION_ADMIN_TOKEN (or ADMIN_TOKEN) is required');
334  assertCondition(
335    allowReset,
336    'Set ALLOW_DEMO_RESET=1 to acknowledge deterministic reset of production demo data',
337  );
338  // Отдельный post-Playwright режим не повторяет матрицу, а только возвращает и проверяет demo seed.
339  if (finalResetOnly) {
340    await client.reset();
341    const [recovery, ready] = await Promise.all([
342      client.adminGet<unknown[]>('/api/v1/admin/recovery/orders'),
343      client.json<{ status: string }>('/api/health/ready'),
344    ]);
345    assertCondition(
346      recovery.status === 200 && recovery.body.length === 0,
347      'Recovery list is not empty',
348    );
349    assertCondition(ready.status === 200 && ready.body.status === 'ok', 'Final ready check failed');
350    console.log('Production demo reset verified: recovery=0, ready=ok.');
351    return;
352  }
353  try {
354    await scenario(
355      'HTTPS surface, health, catalog, OpenAPI, metrics and admin guard',
356      verifySurface,
357    );
358    await scenario(
359      'idempotent double click, conflict and money tamper rejection',
360      verifyIdempotency,
361    );
362    await scenario('50 identical + 50 unique paid webhooks on production', verifyWebhookRaces);
363    await scenario('early and unordered payment events', verifyOrdering);
364    await scenario('out-of-stock recovery and concurrent manual retry', verifyOutOfStock);
365    await scenario('timeout-after-issue safe replay', verifyTimeout);
366    await scenario('Provider A out-of-stock fallback to B', verifyFallback);
367    await scenario('two provider 5xx responses and recovery', verifyProviderFailure);
368    await scenario('LIMIT3 under 50 parallel production requests', verifyPromoRace);
369    await client.reset();
370    await writeReport(true);
371    console.log(`\nProduction acceptance complete: ${evidence.length}/9 scenarios passed.`);
372  } catch (error) {
373    // Даже неуспешная диагностика пытается вернуть чистый seed; исходную ошибку при этом не скрываем.
374    try {
375      await client.reset();
376    } catch (resetError) {
377      console.error(`Final recovery reset failed: ${errorMessage(resetError)}`);
378    }
379    await writeReport(false, error);
380    throw error;
381  }
382}

18/** Опросом ждёт произвольное состояние БД с ограниченным сроком ожидания. */
19async function waitForDatabase(
20  predicate: () => Promise<boolean>,
21  message: string,
22  timeoutMs = 10_000,
23): Promise<void> {
24  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
25  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
26    if (await predicate()) return;
27    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
28  }
29  throw new Error(message);
30}

32/** Проверяет три независимых доказательства однократности: fulfillment, key и event count. */
33async function assertSingleIssue(orderId: string, expectedEvents: number): Promise<void> {
34  const order = await prisma.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { publicId: orderId } });
35  const [fulfillments, events, requests, jobs] = await Promise.all([
36    prisma.fulfillment.count({ where: { orderId: order.id } }),
37    prisma.paymentEvent.count({ where: { orderPublicId: orderId } }),
38    prisma.providerRequest.findMany({ where: { orderId: order.id }, select: { requestId: true } }),
39    prisma.deliveryJob.count({ where: { orderId: order.id } }),
40  ]);
41  const spentKeys = await prisma.providerKey.count({
42    where: { requestId: { in: requests.map((item) => item.requestId) } },
43  });
44  assertCondition(
45    fulfillments === 1 && spentKeys === 1 && events === expectedEvents && jobs === 1,
46    JSON.stringify({ orderId, fulfillments, spentKeys, events, expectedEvents, jobs }),
47  );
48}

69    tutorial,

103    ['/api/v1/orders/{orderId}', 'get'],
104    ['/api/v1/payments/simulate', 'post'],
105    ['/api/v1/webhooks/payment', 'post'],
106    ['/api/v1/promocodes/quote', 'post'],
107    ['/api/v1/admin/recovery/orders', 'get'],

109    ['/api/v1/admin/providers/keys', 'post'],
110    ['/api/v1/admin/providers/mode', 'post'],
111    ['/api/v1/admin/demo/reset', 'post'],
112    ['/api/health/live', 'get'],
113    ['/api/health/ready', 'get'],
114    ['/api/metrics', 'get'],
115  ];
116  for (const [path, method] of requiredOperations) {

118  }

120    metrics.status === 200 && metrics.body.includes('shop_delivery_queue_length'),
121    'Prometheus metrics are incomplete',
122  );
123  assertCondition(
124    docs.status === 200 && docs.body.includes('swagger-ui'),
125    'Swagger UI is unavailable',

127  // Публичный домен и локальный стек должны раздавать один и тот же учебный комплект.
128  assertCondition(
129    tutorial.status === 200 &&
130      tutorial.body.includes('Fullstack Test Shop — интерактивный учебник') &&
131      offline.status === 200 &&
132      offline.body.includes('Исходный код, который можно изучать офлайн') &&
133      readme.status === 200 &&
134      readme.body.includes('# fullstack-test-shop') &&
135      codemap.status === 200 &&
136      codemap.body.includes('# CODEMAP: от требования к точной строке кода'),
137    'Public documentation bundle is unavailable or stale',
138  );
139  assertCondition(unauthorized.status === 401, 'Admin API is not fail-closed');

141  const malformed = await client.json('/api/v1/orders/not-a-uuid');
142  assertCondition(malformed.status === 400, 'Malformed public UUID must return HTTP 400');

145/** Доказывает HTTP/DB-идемпотентность заказа и недоверие к цене клиента. */
146async function verifyOrderIdempotency(): Promise<void> {
147  await client.reset();
148  const intent = newIntent();
149  const doubleClick = await Promise.all([
150    client.createOrder({ intent }),
151    client.createOrder({ intent }),
152  ]);
153  const statuses = doubleClick.map((item) => item.status).sort();
154  assertCondition(
155    statuses[0] === 200 && statuses[1] === 201,
156    `Double click returned ${statuses.join(', ')}`,
157  );
158  assertCondition(
159    doubleClick[0].body.orderId === doubleClick[1].body.orderId,
160    'Double click created different public orders',
161  );
162  assertCondition(
163    (await prisma.order.count({ where: { idempotencyKey: intent.idempotencyKey } })) === 1,
164    'Double click inserted more than one order row',
165  );
166 
167  const changedPayload = await client.createOrder({ intent, sku: 'STEAM-TOPUP-1000' });
168  assertCondition(
169    changedPayload.status === 409,
170    'Changed idempotency payload must return HTTP 409',
171  );
172  const reusedPublicId = await client.createOrder({
173    intent: { orderId: intent.orderId, idempotencyKey: randomUUID() },
174  });
175  assertCondition(reusedPublicId.status === 409, 'Reused public orderId must return HTTP 409');
176 
177  const beforeTamper = await prisma.order.count();
178  const tampered = await client.createOrder({ extraBody: { finalPriceMinor: 1, currency: 'USD' } });
179  assertCondition(tampered.status === 400, 'Client-controlled money fields must be rejected');
180  assertCondition(
181    (await prisma.order.count()) === beforeTamper,
182    'Tampered request inserted an order',
183  );
184  assertCondition(
185    doubleClick[0].body.finalPriceMinor === 50_000 && doubleClick[0].body.currency === 'RUB',
186    'Order did not use the server catalog snapshot',
187  );
188}

190/** Атакует один заказ 50 одинаковыми webhook и доказывает полный no-op повторов event_id. */
191async function verifyDuplicateWebhooks(): Promise<void> {
192  await client.reset();
193  const order = await client.createOrder();
194  assertCondition(order.status === 201, 'Order creation failed');
195  const eventId = `evt_${randomUUID()}`;
196  const deliveries = await Promise.all(
197    Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => client.webhook({ orderId: order.body.orderId, eventId })),
198  );
199  assertCondition(
200    deliveries.every((item) => item.status === 200),
201    'Webhook did not answer 200',
202  );
203  const delivered = await client.waitForStatus(order.body.orderId, 'delivered');
204  await assertSingleIssue(order.body.orderId, 1);
205 
206  const snapshot = {
207    status: delivered.status,
208    code: delivered.code,
209    history: delivered.history.map((item) => `${item.from}->${item.to}:${item.reason}`),
210  };
211  await Promise.all(
212    Array.from({ length: 10 }, () => client.webhook({ orderId: order.body.orderId, eventId })),
213  );
214  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
215  const replayed = (await client.order(order.body.orderId)).body;
216  assertCondition(
217    JSON.stringify({
218      status: replayed.status,
219      code: replayed.code,
220      history: replayed.history.map((item) => `${item.from}->${item.to}:${item.reason}`),
221    }) === JSON.stringify(snapshot),
222    'Repeated event_id changed the delivered order',
223  );
224  await assertSingleIssue(order.body.orderId, 1);
225}

242/** Проверяет раннее событие, failed→paid и запрет регрессии delivered от позднего failed. */
243async function verifyEarlyAndUnorderedEvents(): Promise<void> {
244  await client.reset();
245  const earlyIntent = newIntent();
246  const earlyEventId = `evt_${randomUUID()}`;
247  const early = await client.webhook({ orderId: earlyIntent.orderId, eventId: earlyEventId });
248  assertCondition(early.status === 200, 'Early webhook was not durably accepted');

250    (await prisma.paymentEvent.findUnique({ where: { eventId: earlyEventId } }))?.inboxState ===
251      'pending',
252    'Early webhook was not retained as pending',
253  );
254  await client.createOrder({ intent: earlyIntent });
255  await client.waitForStatus(earlyIntent.orderId, 'delivered');
256  await assertSingleIssue(earlyIntent.orderId, 1);
257 
258  const unordered = await client.createOrder();
259  await client.webhook({ orderId: unordered.body.orderId, status: 'failed' });
260  await client.waitForStatus(unordered.body.orderId, 'payment_failed');
261  await client.webhook({ orderId: unordered.body.orderId, status: 'paid' });
262  const delivered = await client.waitForStatus(unordered.body.orderId, 'delivered');

265  await waitForDatabase(
266    async () =>
267      (await prisma.paymentEvent.count({ where: { orderPublicId: unordered.body.orderId } })) === 3,
268    'Late failed event was not processed',
269  );
270  const afterLateFailure = (await client.order(unordered.body.orderId)).body;
271  assertCondition(
272    afterLateFailure.status === 'delivered' && afterLateFailure.code === code,
273    'Late failed event regressed a delivered order',
274  );
275  await assertSingleIssue(unordered.body.orderId, 3);
276}

318/** Опустошает оба реальных пула и проверяет recovery, пополнение и повторный идемпотентный retry. */

326    '/api/v1/admin/recovery/orders',
327  );
328  assertCondition(
329    recovery.status === 200 &&
330      recovery.body.some(
331        (item) => item.orderId === order.body.orderId && item.status === 'out_of_stock',
332      ),
333    'Recoverable order is absent from admin list',
334  );
335  const added = await client.adminPost<{ added: number }>('/api/v1/admin/providers/keys', {
336    providerId: 'A',
337    sku: 'STEAM-TOPUP-500',
338    codes: ['RACE-RECOVERY-0001'],
339  });
340  assertCondition(added.status === 201 && added.body.added === 1, 'Provider pool top-up failed');
341  const retries = await Promise.all([
342    client.adminPost<{ accepted: boolean }>(
343      `/api/v1/admin/orders/${order.body.orderId}/retry-delivery`,
344    ),
345    client.adminPost<{ accepted: boolean }>(
346      `/api/v1/admin/orders/${order.body.orderId}/retry-delivery`,
347    ),
348  ]);
349  assertCondition(
350    retries.every((item) => item.status === 202),
351    'Concurrent manual retry failed',
352  );
353  await client.waitForStatus(order.body.orderId, 'delivered');
354  await assertSingleIssue(order.body.orderId, 1);
355  const noOp = await client.adminPost<{ alreadyDelivered: boolean }>(
356    `/api/v1/admin/orders/${order.body.orderId}/retry-delivery`,
357  );
358  assertCondition(noOp.body.alreadyDelivered, 'Retry of delivered order was not a no-op');
359  await assertSingleIssue(order.body.orderId, 1);
360}

362/** Воспроизводит главную timeout-ловушку и запрещает небезопасный переход на Provider B. */
363async function verifyTimeoutReplay(): Promise<void> {
364  await client.reset();
365  await client.adminPost('/api/v1/admin/providers/mode', {
366    providerId: 'A',
367    mode: 'timeout_after_issue',
368    delayMs: 1500,
369  });
370  const order = await client.createOrder();
371  await client.webhook({ orderId: order.body.orderId });
372  await client.waitForStatus(order.body.orderId, 'delivered');
373  await assertSingleIssue(order.body.orderId, 1);
374  const record = await prisma.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { publicId: order.body.orderId } });
375  const [attempts, requestsB] = await Promise.all([
376    prisma.providerCallAttempt.groupBy({
377      by: ['outcome'],
378      where: { providerRequest: { orderId: record.id, providerId: 'A' } },
379      _count: { _all: true },
380    }),
381    prisma.providerRequest.count({ where: { orderId: record.id, providerId: 'B' } }),
382  ]);
383  assertCondition(
384    attempts.some((item) => item.outcome === 'timeout') &&
385      attempts.some((item) => item.outcome === 'success'),
386    `Timeout replay outcomes are incomplete: ${JSON.stringify(attempts)}`,
387  );
388  assertCondition(requestsB === 0, 'Ambiguous Provider A timeout incorrectly fell back to B');
389}

429    })

454/** Проверяет quote, идемпотентный redemption и строгий LIMIT3 под 50 конкурентными заказами. */
455async function verifyPromocodes(): Promise<void> {
456  await client.reset();
457  const quote = await client.json<{
458    basePriceMinor: number;
459    discountMinor: number;
460    finalPriceMinor: number;
461    remainingUses: number;
462  }>('/api/v1/promocodes/quote', {
463    method: 'POST',
464    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
465    body: JSON.stringify({ sku: 'STEAM-TOPUP-500', promoCode: ' welcome10 ' }),
466  });
467  assertCondition(
468    quote.status === 201 &&
469      quote.body.basePriceMinor === 50_000 &&
470      quote.body.discountMinor === 5_000 &&
471      quote.body.finalPriceMinor === 45_000 &&
472      quote.body.remainingUses === 100,
473    'WELCOME10 quote is incorrect',
474  );
475  assertCondition(
476    (await prisma.promocode.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'WELCOME10' } })).usedCount === 0,
477    'Quote consumed a promocode use',
478  );
479 
480  const onceIntent = newIntent();
481  const once = await client.createOrder({ promoCode: 'ONCEONLY', intent: onceIntent });
482  const onceReplay = await client.createOrder({ promoCode: ' onceonly ', intent: onceIntent });
483  const onceRejected = await client.createOrder({ promoCode: 'ONCEONLY' });
484  assertCondition(
485    once.status === 201 && onceReplay.status === 200,
486    'Promo replay is not idempotent',
487  );
488  assertCondition(onceRejected.status === 409, 'ONCEONLY exceeded max_uses=1');
489  assertCondition(
490    (await prisma.promocode.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ONCEONLY' } })).usedCount === 1,
491    'Idempotent promo replay incremented used_count twice',
492  );
493 
494  await client.reset();
495  const concurrent = await Promise.all(
496    Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => client.createOrder({ promoCode: 'LIMIT3' })),
497  );
498  const successes = concurrent.filter((item) => item.status === 201).length;
499  const conflicts = concurrent.filter((item) => item.status === 409).length;
500  const promo = await prisma.promocode.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'LIMIT3' } });
501  const redemptions = await prisma.promoRedemption.count({ where: { promocodeId: promo.id } });
502  assertCondition(
503    successes === 3 && conflicts === 47 && promo.usedCount === 3 && redemptions === 3,
504    JSON.stringify({ successes, conflicts, usedCount: promo.usedCount, redemptions }),
505  );
506}

508/** Проверяет детерминированный reset и его отказ удалять данные при processing job. */
509async function verifySafeReset(): Promise<void> {

513  await prisma.deliveryJob.create({

520  });
521  const blocked = await client.adminPost('/api/v1/admin/demo/reset');
522  assertCondition(blocked.status === 503, 'Reset did not reject an active processing job');
523  assertCondition((await prisma.order.count()) === 1, 'Blocked reset deleted demo data');
524  await prisma.deliveryJob.update({
525    where: { orderId: dbOrder.id },
526    data: { status: 'failed', leaseUntil: null },
527  });
528  await client.reset();
529  const [orders, events, keys, usedPromos, badModes] = await Promise.all([
530    prisma.order.count(),
531    prisma.paymentEvent.count(),
532    prisma.providerKey.count(),
533    prisma.promocode.count({ where: { usedCount: { not: 0 } } }),
534    prisma.providerSetting.count({ where: { faultMode: { not: 'success' } } }),
535  ]);
536  assertCondition(
537    orders === 0 &&
538      events === 0 &&
539      keys === INITIAL_PROVIDER_KEYS.length &&
540      usedPromos === 0 &&
541      badModes === 0,
542    JSON.stringify({ orders, events, keys, usedPromos, badModes }),
543  );
544}

546/** Последовательно запускает полную приемочную матрицу на живом API и настоящем PostgreSQL. */
547async function main(): Promise<void> {
548  const checks: Array<[string, () => Promise<void>]> = [
549    ['contracts, seed, health, metrics and admin protection', verifyContracts],
550    ['double click, idempotency conflicts and server-owned price', verifyOrderIdempotency],
551    ['50 identical webhooks and strict duplicate no-op', verifyDuplicateWebhooks],
552    ['50 unique paid webhooks: one job, fulfillment and key', verifyUniquePaidRace],
553    ['early and unordered payment events without regression', verifyEarlyAndUnorderedEvents],
554    ['amount and currency snapshot validation', verifyPaymentSnapshotValidation],
555    ['payment simulator delivers a real webhook', verifyPaymentSimulator],
556    ['empty pools, admin recovery and idempotent retry', verifyOutOfStockRecovery],
557    ['timeout-after-issue reuses A request and never calls B', verifyTimeoutReplay],
558    ['explicit Provider A out-of-stock safely falls back to B', verifyProviderFallback],
559    [
560      'both providers failing remain recoverable with stable request IDs',
561      verifyDeliveryFailureRecovery,
562    ],
563    ['promo quote, replay and LIMIT3 under 50 requests', verifyPromocodes],
564    ['reset is deterministic and blocked by processing jobs', verifySafeReset],
565  ];
566  for (const [name, check] of checks) await scenario(name, check);
567  console.log(`\nAcceptance complete: ${results.length}/${checks.length} scenarios passed.`);
568}
569 
570// CLI всегда закрывает Prisma и возвращает ненулевой exit code при любой нарушенной гарантии.
571main()
572  .then(() => prisma.$disconnect())
573  .catch(async (error: unknown) => {
574    console.error(error);
575    await prisma.$disconnect();
576    process.exitCode = 1;
577  });

38/**
39 * Минимальный клиент живого магазина, одинаково работающий с localhost и production HTTPS.
40 * Он намеренно общается только по публичным HTTP-контрактам и не подменяет приложение моками.
41 */
42export class LiveShopClient {
43  /** Нормализует origin и сохраняет admin token только в памяти текущего тестового процесса. */
44  constructor(
45    readonly baseUrl: string,
46    private readonly adminToken: string,
47  ) {
48    this.baseUrl = baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '');
49  }
50 
51  /** Выполняет HTTP-запрос и безопасно разбирает JSON даже для ответов об ошибке. */
52  async json<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<HttpResult<T>> {
53    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}${path}`, init);
54    const text = await response.text();
55    let body: T;
56    try {
57      body = (text ? JSON.parse(text) : undefined) as T;
58    } catch {
59      throw new Error(`${path} returned non-JSON HTTP ${response.status}: ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
60    }
61    return { status: response.status, body, headers: response.headers };
62  }
63 
64  /** Возвращает сырой текст для Prometheus и других не-JSON endpoints. */
65  async text(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<HttpResult<string>> {
66    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}${path}`, init);
67    return { status: response.status, body: await response.text(), headers: response.headers };
68  }
69 
70  /** Создаёт заказ с серверной ценой, позволяя явно переиспользовать purchase intent. */
71  createOrder(options?: {
72    promoCode?: string;
73    intent?: PurchaseIntent;
74    sku?: string;
75    extraBody?: Record<string, unknown>;
76  }): Promise<HttpResult<OrderView>> {
77    const intent = options?.intent ?? newIntent();
78    return this.json<OrderView>('/api/v1/orders', {
79      method: 'POST',
80      headers: {
81        'content-type': 'application/json',
82        'Idempotency-Key': intent.idempotencyKey,
83      },
84      body: JSON.stringify({
85        orderId: intent.orderId,
86        sku: options?.sku ?? 'STEAM-TOPUP-500',
87        ...(options?.promoCode ? { promoCode: options.promoCode } : {}),
88        ...options?.extraBody,
89      }),
90    });
91  }
92 
93  /** Читает актуальный read model заказа с историей и выданным кодом. */
94  order(orderId: string): Promise<HttpResult<OrderView>> {
95    return this.json<OrderView>(`/api/v1/orders/${orderId}`);
96  }
97 
98  /** Отправляет событие по точному webhook-контракту исходного задания. */
99  webhook(options: {
100    orderId: string;
101    eventId?: string;
102    status?: 'paid' | 'failed';
103    amount?: number;
104    currency?: string;
105    createdAt?: string;
106  }): Promise<HttpResult<{ accepted: boolean; duplicate: boolean }>> {
107    return this.json('/api/v1/webhooks/payment', {
108      method: 'POST',
109      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
110      body: JSON.stringify({
111        event_id: options.eventId ?? `evt_${randomUUID()}`,
112        order_id: options.orderId,
113        status: options.status ?? 'paid',
114        amount: options.amount ?? 500,
115        currency: options.currency ?? 'RUB',
116        created_at: options.createdAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
117      }),
118    });
119  }
120 
121  /** Вызывает учебный платёжный симулятор, который сам доставляет настоящий webhook по HTTP. */
122  simulate(
123    orderId: string,
124    status: 'paid' | 'failed',
125  ): Promise<HttpResult<{ accepted: boolean; eventId: string }>> {
126    return this.json('/api/v1/payments/simulate', {
127      method: 'POST',
128      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
129      body: JSON.stringify({ orderId, status }),
130    });
131  }
132 
133  /** Выполняет защищённый POST административного API, не выводя токен в лог. */
134  adminPost<T>(path: string, body: unknown = {}): Promise<HttpResult<T>> {
135    return this.json<T>(path, {
136      method: 'POST',
137      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'X-Admin-Token': this.adminToken },
138      body: JSON.stringify(body),
139    });
140  }
141 
142  /** Выполняет защищённый GET административного API. */
143  adminGet<T>(path: string): Promise<HttpResult<T>> {
144    return this.json<T>(path, { headers: { 'X-Admin-Token': this.adminToken } });
145  }
146 
147  /** Возвращает демо-БД и оба поставщика к воспроизводимому исходному состоянию. */
148  async reset(): Promise<void> {
149    const result = await this.adminPost<{ reset: boolean }>('/api/v1/admin/demo/reset');
150    assertCondition(
151      result.status === 201 && result.body.reset,
152      `Demo reset failed: ${result.status}`,
153    );
154  }
155 
156  /** Ждёт один из ожидаемых статусов с deadline, чтобы зависание превратилось в явный тестовый сбой. */
157  async waitForStatus(
158    orderId: string,
159    expected: string | readonly string[],
160    timeoutMs = 20_000,
161  ): Promise<OrderView> {
162    const statuses = Array.isArray(expected) ? expected : [expected];
163    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
164    let latest = 'unknown';
165    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
166      const result = await this.order(orderId);
167      latest = result.body.status;
168      if (result.status === 200 && statuses.includes(latest)) return result.body;
169      // Небольшая задержка позволяет worker'у работать, не превращая polling в busy loop.
170      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
171    }
172    throw new Error(`Order ${orderId} stayed ${latest}; expected ${statuses.join(' or ')}`);
173  }
174}
